hero.title: A Thai virtual number for SMS verification
intro: Thailand is LINE country. The green messenger is where Thais chat, pay, follow shops and read the news — and a LINE account starts with a phone number. A +66 mobile is the natural way in, and it opens the rest of the Thai app world too: Shopee for shopping, Grab for rides and food.
SMS Code rents you a real Thai mobile number in one tap. Enter it at the verification step, and the SMS with your code shows up in the app usually within seconds — receive it, copy it, done.

whyCountry.title: Why choose a Thai number?
body: Pick Thailand when the account you're building lives in Southeast Asia's ecosystem. LINE is the headline act — verifying it with a Thai number is the local-standard route — but Shopee and Grab accounts anchored to a +66 mobile look exactly like the millions of real ones created every month. Global messengers accept Thai numbers just as readily.

Thai mobiles are written domestically as ten digits starting with 0 — the prefixes 06, 08 and 09 all mark mobile ranges. In international form the leading zero drops: +66 and then nine digits. Once that swap is made, the number reads cleanly in any verification form.

tips.title: Trade the zero for +66
tips.body: A Thai mobile like 08X XXX XXXX becomes +66 8X XXX XXXX internationally — the zero and the country code never appear together. If a form rejects your number as invalid, the stowaway zero is the first thing to check.

tips.title: LINE is the local standard
tips.body: In Thailand a messenger account means a LINE account, and Thai numbers verify it constantly — the flow is quick and predictable. Keep the SMS Code app open when you request the code; LINE's SMS usually lands within seconds.

tips.title: Code first, everything else after
tips.body: The rental covers a limited window for the SMS to arrive. Enter the number and request the code as soon as you take it — and if nothing arrives, cancel free and take a fresh Thai number instead of waiting the window out.

faqs.q: Is it a real Thai mobile number?
faqs.a: Yes — a real carrier-network number in Thailand's standard mobile format. Services see an ordinary Thai phone, the same as one that came with a local SIM.

faqs.q: What are Thai numbers typically used for?
faqs.a: LINE is the big one — it's Thailand's default messenger and its accounts are anchored to phone numbers. Shopee and Grab are the other regulars, with WhatsApp and Telegram verifying against Thai numbers just as smoothly.

faqs.q: Do I have to be in Thailand to receive the SMS?
faqs.a: No. The number and its messages live in the SMS Code app, so your location and your own SIM card don't enter into it — the code reaches you wherever you are.

faqs.q: What if the verification code never arrives?
faqs.a: Then the activation costs you nothing. Cancel it in the app, take a fresh Thai number and request the code again — you only pay for activations that deliver an SMS.

faqs.q: Can I reuse the number for another service later?
faqs.a: Each activation is tied to one service for its window. If you need to verify several services, run separate activations — each one is paid from your coin balance individually.
